about: Pipeline states sampled for the benchmark-score timeline (timeline/README.md). Chosen from the pipeline history: one commit per behaviour change that a benchmark could see, plus two controls that should score the same as their predecessor. `era` is the RecordingPipeline entry point (A–D, timeline/worker.ts). `needsLegacyDeps`: the commit still imports @spotify/basic-pitch, so it runs on the shared legacy install (prepare.ts) instead of HEAD's node_modules. prepare.ts verifies every field against git.

commits.subject: feat log notes in debug bundle
commits.why: First basic-pitch-only pipeline runnable on the shared deps (tfjs 4.22).

commits.subject: feat: take chromaticTranspose into account
commits.why: End of the single-provider era (AudioConverter); NoteExtractor and decoder changed since bb4d8165. Code-default provider basic-pitch.

commits.subject: feat: remove pesto provider
commits.why: Adaptive pipeline (ef81d2d0) + OnsetDetector + legato extension, without the onnxruntime import; equivalent to e9a049b1+b6a168bb since the removed providers were unused.

commits.subject: feat(recording): improve real voice/whistle transcription + real-data eval
commits.why: Real-voice fixes: 16th-grid cap, semitone-merge segmentation, smoothing (largest claimed early gain).

commits.subject: feat: use windowed buffers in BE
commits.why: Streaming ffmpeg decode + windowed transcription: a change in the product path only.

commits.subject: feat(api): noise-hardened profile scan — correct registers under adverse audio
commits.why: Noise-hardened pitch scan; first sample with the recordings/pipeline/ kebab-case layout.

commits.subject: feat(api): recording-pipeline accuracy pass — measured fixes + eval overhaul
commits.why: Accuracy pass: extractor float fix, reverb-adaptive gate, metrical spelling, held-note bar emission, whistle range.

commits.subject: feat: add separate pipeline for voice audio
commits.why: VoiceNoteDecoder + YAMNet source classifier + sourceKind in setMeta.

commits.subject: feat: improve rhythm on voice recordings
commits.why: Voice rhythm and notation (mxml-builder, voice-notation): visible only on the measure-level path, which is the one the timeline scores.

commits.subject: feat: two-tier absolute silence rule, exactly inert (R25)
commits.why: CONTROL: end of the 16-commit plugin-source pass, nearly all off by default or measured nulls. Should score ≈ 0b217b4f.

commits.subject: feat: very-high band joins the track cache; split levers measured, floor trap caught
commits.why: basic-pitch deleted (458b3a05): very-high band on octave-down CREPE; first sample on HEAD's deps.

commits.subject: eval: resolver-env signature on both caches; lead-in probe; kill-switches
commits.why: Profile lock waits through a silent lead-in + final reroute. Committed benchmark result at this sha (baseline-2026-09-01) for calibration.

commits.subject: feat(recordings): per-family onset policy + one note per grid slot, from the synthetic corpus
commits.why: Per-family onset policy + collapseCoincident. Committed benchmark result at this sha (onset-policy) for calibration.

commits.subject: docs(meta): Phase 3 (aesthetics) section; TL;DR and follow-ups updated
commits.why: CONTROL: the 2026-10-22 refactors (claimed behaviour-preserving) and the AudioDecoder loudnorm-default flip; no pipeline change after. Should score ≈ d77db1db.

commits.subject: Merge branch 'pa-advh2-hardening': ADV-H2 neutral on silence/noise, drift tolerance
commits.why: The 2026-11 pipeline-accuracy pass: voice onset shift 0.05 s (SING-H1), same-pitch gap bridge for sustained instruments (INST-H4), held notes committed at full length while streaming.

commits.subject: fix(recordings): the voice existence test never judges below the reporting shift
commits.why: SDRY-1: the voice decode judges note existence at the 0.07 calibration while reporting onsets at 0.05 (restores the 100 ms note floor SING-H1 had lowered). Committed benchmark result at this sha (pipeline-accuracy-2026-11) for calibration.
